questions.prompt: The Spanish Armada sailed in which year?
questions.fact: The fleet was scattered by fireships at Calais before any decisive battle was fought.

questions.prompt: Which type of rock is marble?
questions.fact: It starts as limestone, and heat and pressure recrystallise it into the interlocking grains that take a polish.

questions.prompt: What is the length of a cricket pitch between the wickets?
questions.fact: That distance equals one chain, an old surveying unit that also explains the length of a furlong.

questions.prompt: Which video game features a character called Link?
questions.fact: Zelda is the princess, not the hero, which is among the most persistent misconceptions in gaming.

questions.prompt: Which island nation lies southeast of Florida?
questions.fact: It is an archipelago of some 700 islands, only about thirty of which are inhabited.

questions.prompt: Which novel features a character called Yuri Zhivago?
questions.fact: It was banned at home and smuggled out for publication in Italy, which is how it reached the world.

questions.prompt: Which storage technology uses magnetic tape?
questions.fact: Tape is still used for long-term archives because it is cheap, durable and cannot be altered remotely.
